 Order

1.
The present matter has been listed on an office note.

2.  It has been pointed out in the office note that the FIR number, Sections and the Police Station have inadvertently been mentioned as "FIR No. 0106/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at Police Station Tilak Nagar" instead of "FIR No. 0145/2021 under Sections 354/354A IPC registered at Police Station Defence Colony" in Para 13 of the order dated 30.10.2023, vide which the petition was disposed of.

3. In view of the above, the para 13 of order dated 30.10.2023 is corrected to be read as under:-
"Consequently, the petition is allowed and the FIR No.0145/2021 under Sections 354/354A IPC registered at Police Station Defence Colony along with other proceedings emanating therefrom
